title: Playback Transcode Startup Degradation
problem: Playback startup is coupled to successful HLS transcode planning, so missing FFmpeg software encoders can block admin and unrelated playback surfaces.

evidence.summary: Opened the playback transcode startup degradation lane and accepted ADR 0048.
Split HLS startup state into typed readiness plus an optional executable pipeline plan.
Updated Admin playback runtime diagnostics to report unavailable HLS readiness and zero selected HLS slots.
Ran focused playback gates and closed the startup degradation lane.

continue_policy.notes: The startup degradation lane is complete. Split source decoder requirements, HLS muxer/protocol probing, and frontend diagnostic rendering into separate follow-ons.
